name: Nakadashi AV Satsuei ~JK Okami Onsen Settai Anata no Musume ga AV Shutsuen Shimasu~
original_name: 膣内射精AV撮影 ～JK女将温泉接待 あなたの娘がAV出演します～
source:
The protagonist had been running a long-established inn with his beloved daughter, Rin.
But in the midst of an economic downturn, the inn’s finances collapsed.
That’s when the yakuza showed up to collect their debts—and made a devilish offer.

"Let Rin star in an adult video, and we’ll give you an additional loan."

After agonizing over the decision, the protagonist made the worst choice imaginable.
The place filled with cherished memories of time spent with his daughter became the set for an adult film.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181103132937/http://www.phantomsoft.info/08_re_okami/index.html#Story]the official website[/url]]
translation:
主人公与心爱的女儿凛一起经营着一家老字号旅馆。
但在经济衰退期间，旅馆的财务崩溃了。
就在这时，黑帮出现了，想要讨债，并提出了一个邪恶的提议。

“让凛出演成人视频，我们会额外给你贷款。”

主人公在苦苦思索之后，做出了最糟糕的选择。
这个充满与女儿共度时光的珍贵回忆的地方成为了一部成人电影的拍摄地。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20181103132937/http://www.phantomsoft.info/08_re_okami/index.html#Story]官方网站[/url]]
